checks.title: Postgres trust-state store
checks.evidence: Production source-of-truth database is not configured.
checks.remediation: Configure a dedicated QR Trust Postgres database and keep publisher or other app databases separate.

checks.title: Migration ledger gate
checks.evidence: Migration ledger gate is not enabled.
checks.remediation: Apply and verify reference migrations through the migration ledger before workers write state.

checks.title: Backup and restore automation
checks.remediation: Add backup execution, restore drill, and rollback ownership before production deployment.

checks.title: Packaged deployment ownership
checks.evidence: Packaged deployment ownership is not documented.
checks.remediation: Assign owners for deployable artifacts, image provenance, release approval, environment promotion, and rollback before production deployment.

checks.title: NATS JetStream propagation
checks.evidence: NATS propagation URL is not configured.
checks.remediation: Configure NATS JetStream for propagation after Postgres-backed artifacts are durable.

checks.title: Managed public-key material source
checks.evidence: Managed key-material provider is not configured.
checks.remediation: Wire KMS, HSM, or another managed source for public verification material references.

checks.title: Managed signing custody
checks.evidence: Managed signing custody provider is not configured.
checks.remediation: Move artifact signing into a managed KMS or HSM custody provider before production issuance.

checks.title: Custody audit export
checks.evidence: Custody audit export is not configured.
checks.remediation: Export signing custody audit events to an operator-owned audit trail.

checks.title: Live runtime-safety provider
checks.evidence: Live runtime-safety provider is not configured.
checks.remediation: Configure a live safe-browsing, reputation, redirect, or TLS inspector with privacy boundaries.

checks.title: Scanner-visible decision persistence
checks.evidence: Scanner decision persistence is enabled. Evidence references are missing.
checks.remediation: Persist scanner-visible green, orange, and red outcomes for audit and review.

checks.title: Worker operations evidence packet
checks.evidence: Worker operations evidence packet is not configured.
checks.remediation: Attach a worker operations evidence packet before claiming production readiness.

checks.title: Operator runbooks
checks.remediation: Document issuance, key rotation, provider outage, worker recovery, and rollback procedures.
